notes: Fresh Sep 16 Toronto-morning B_V1 review of all 164 judge candidates. Entity-accuracy hard rejects were applied aggressively to common-word/ticker collisions and unrelated mappings; evergreen commentary and generic predictions were rejected. Duplicate Federal Reserve, SK hynix/Intel and other repeated angles were collapsed to one underlying event. Fifteen distinct events cleared the conservative gate; fewer than 20 were retained rather than padding. Evidence arrays preserve the supplied judge-review evidence used for semantic judging, while upstream evidence counts remain intact.
